Ash K.: Quick RFC follow-up: we need a crisp runtime<>profile contract for precision profiles (FP8/INT8/4bit). Current ambiguity is causing ops work during canaries :/
Ravi P.: +1. Can you call out the two main failure modes you saw?
Ash K.: 1) model rejects quant profile at load-time, 2) silent quality shifts under load when fallback kicks in. Both surface as SLO blips.
Claire S.: For (1) we should have an explicit compatibility check API: `validate_profile(model_id, profile_spec) -> {ok|errors}`. That avoids load-time surprises.
Mike L.: agree. Also need a stable hash for profile artifacts so Dedicated/Private can pin them. `profile_id = sha256(profile_spec)`
Ash K.: Good point. For (2) ops need signalization in traces when fallback occurs (which quant lane we picked, degradation score).
Ravi P.: Telemetry fields proposal: `quant_lane`, `profile_id`, `fallback_reason`, `deg_score` (0-1). Add `prompt_bucket` when possible.
Claire S.: We should also add an opt-in runtime check mode: runtime samples N outputs and runs a lightweight eval against reference model for canary windows. Toggle via endpoint header.
Mike L.: Danger: sampling increases p99 latency. Keep sample path async and tag traces. Maybe put samples onto a separate aggregator queue.
Ash K.: Ops action: provide a fallback policy DSL with three levels: soft (warn + continue), strict (reject request), escrow (route to higher-fidelity model). We map per-customer SLA to default.
Ravi P.: Implementation note: policy should be evaluated before batching to avoid mixing lanes. Add an `eval_priority` flag to request metadata.
Claire S.: Long-term refactor idea: move profile negotiation into the control plane so runtime only gets resolved profile_id + kernels. That separates verification from hot path.
Mike L.: +1. That means runtime interface shrinks to `serve(profile_id, model_checksum, runtime_hints)` and runtime returns `served_lane` and telemetry. Simpler to certify.
Ash K.: I'll draft a small RFC to: (a) add `validate_profile` API, (b) telemetry schema, (c) fallback DSL sketch, (d) control-plane negotiation sketch.
infra-bot: Deploy check OK — prod-runtime image v2.34 passed smoke tests. :white_check_mark:
Ravi P.: Nice. Can we add a short migration checklist for Dedicated customers who might have custom kernels?
Claire S.: Yes, checklist: pin profile_id, run `validate_profile`, run canary in sandbox for 48h with sampling.
Ash K.: Action items: Claire write telemetry schema, Ravi draft migration checklist, Mike prototype `profile_id` hashing, Ash RFC by EOD Thurs.
Mike L.: I'll try to push a prototype branch today.
Ash K.: Thanks all. Keeping the follow-up tight so ops load drops in next canary.
